reports.title: Pool 12, Mississippi River (Dubuque) fishing report
reports.text:
Black Crappie - Fair: Use a small jig and plastic combination or a live minnow rig in backwater areas with woody structure or along dying vegetation lines, or in side channels where there is a little bit of flow.
Largemouth Bass - Fair: Use spinnerbaits or in-line spinners along vegetation lines in backwater areas, or along areas with rip-rap.
Smallmouth Bass - Fair: Throw inline spinners or crankbaits along rocky areas with some current/current breaks.

reports.title: Cedar River (above Nashua) (Floyd) fishing report
reports.text:
Black Crappie - Excellent: Find crappie near snags in backwater areas. Try a small spinner or crankbait.
Smallmouth Bass - Excellent: Find smallmouth along rocky shorelines, current seams and limestone ledges as they move to deeper water. Try a jig tipped with soft plastics or nightcrawler.

reports.title: Turkey River (above Clermont) (Fayette) fishing report
reports.text: Smallmouth Bass - Excellent: Find smallmouth along rocky shorelines, current seams and limestone ledges as they move to deeper water. Try a jig tipped with soft plastics or nightcrawler.

reports.title: Upper Iowa River (above Decorah) (Winneshiek) fishing report
reports.text: Smallmouth Bass - Excellent: Find smallmouth along rocky shorelines, current seams and limestone ledges as they move to deeper water. Try a jig tipped with soft plastics or nightcrawler.

reports.title: Black Hawk Lake (Sac) fishing report
reports.text: Black Crappie - Fair: Pick up crappie from shore. Use a piece of crawler on a jig or a small minnow along shore in Town Bay and near the inlet bridge area. Fish are up to 12-inches..

reports.title: Swan Lake (Carroll) fishing report
reports.text: Black Crappie - Fair: Target black crappie from the fish house and by the jetties this time of year. Most fish are 9- to 10-inches. Use a small jig tipped with a piece of crawler or minnow fished under a bobber from shore and from the jetties..

reports.title: Big Hollow Lake (Des Moines) fishing report
reports.text: Black Crappie - Fair: Find crappies in the shallower water along the north side of the lake. Expect most of them to be hanging out in 6-8 feet of water in the flooded trees. Minnows and bobbers work best.

reports.title: Lake Belva Deer (Keokuk) fishing report
reports.text:
Black Crappie - Fair: Crappies are holding out in 6 to 8 feet of water along the base of the rip-rap along the dam and in the flooded timber at that same depth from the campground bay to the dam.
Largemouth Bass - Fair: Much like last week: Bass are holding in 4-7 feet of water. Work the flooded trees with some plastics.

reports.title: Lake Darling (Washington) fishing report
reports.text:
Black Crappie - Fair: Crappies are in the shallow water around the rocks and the tree falls. Don't pass by the brush piles across from the main boat ramp. With the stained water, a slower approach such as jigs drifted under bobbers or bobber and minnow works best.
Largemouth Bass - Good: Bass continue to work the shallows, especially those in the 10- to 15-inch range..

reports.title: Lake Geode (Henry) fishing report
reports.text:
Black Crappie - Fair: Look for crappies along the rip-rap in the sunshine and the long mounds across from the beach.
Largemouth Bass - Good: A bunch of aggressive 10- to 12-inch bass (it's a really big age class) are making their way through the population. Try fishing the edges of the water willows and in the 6-8 feet of water around the artificial fish habitat.

reports.title: Lost Grove Lake (Scott) fishing report
reports.text:
Black Crappie - Good: Crappies have moved into the flooded brush and scattered trees in 3 to 6 feet of water. Jigs worked slow or minnow and bobber are working well.
Largemouth Bass - Fair: Continue to work the edges of the weed beds, and if you can back deep in the flooded timber for those bigger ones..

reports.title: Lake Macbride (Johnson) fishing report
reports.text:
Black Crappie - Good: Bite has been inconsistent with some days better than others. Most anglers are using jigs tipped with a minnow or just soft plastics. Anglers have also been using a bobber and minnow set up. Most anglers are targeting brush piles or clusters of stumps..
White Crappie - Good: Bite has been inconsistent with some days better than others. Most anglers are using jigs tipped with a minnow or just soft plastics. Anglers have also been using a bobber and minnow set up. Most anglers are targeting brush piles or clusters of stumps..

reports.title: Lake Miami (Monroe) fishing report
reports.text: Black Crappie - Slow: Target the cedar tree piles and other submerged structure with small jigs.

reports.title: Hickory Grove Lake (Story) fishing report
reports.text: Black Crappie - Fair: Try vertical jigging or slowly trolling small plastics over habitat. Afternoons and early evening bites are best.

reports.title: Viking Lake (Montgomery) fishing report
reports.text:
Black Crappie - Fair: Catch 9-to-10-inch black crappies with minnows under a bobber around the deep tree piles.
Largemouth Bass - Fair: Boat anglers are finding largemouth bass in shallow tree piles.

reports.title: Lake Hendricks (Howard) fishing report
reports.text:
Black Crappie - Good: Find crappie around submersed or downed trees or logs. Try a small spinner or crankbait.
Largemouth Bass - Good: Toss a crank or spinner bait along a rocky shoreline or drop-off. Keep tension on the line to prevent losing your lure.

reports.text:

Largemouth Bass - Good: Anglers are using chatter and spinner baits.

Largemouth Bass - Fair: Bass anglers are finding fish in deep tree piles and along the roadbed.

reports.title: Lake Delhi (Delaware) fishing report
reports.text:
Black Crappie - Fair: Anglers are catching bass and some crappie.
Largemouth Bass - Fair: Cast artificial lures or crankbaits along shoreline areas and around the docks.
White Crappie - Fair: Try fishing around shoreline structure near fallen trees in the 8-10 feet of water jigging colored tube jigs or hair jigs. A live minnow tipped under a slip bobber can be very effective.

reports.text: White Crappie - Status Unsure: Try vertical jigging with minnows or floating minnows under a bobber around brush piles in the backwaters and side channels. Places to try are Sunset Marina and the Andalusia Island complex..

reports.title: Pool 09, Mississippi River (Allamakee) fishing report
reports.text:
Black Crappie - Fair: Crappie bite is improving. Use light tackle in 4-6 feet of water in trees and stumps in slight current..
Largemouth Bass - Good: Largemouth fall feeding is underway. Cast plastics or buzz-baits along thick vegetation in upper portions of backwaters..
Smallmouth Bass - Excellent: Smallmouth bass are prepping for winter and actively feeding along main channel. Use inline spinner-baits along rip-rap.
